timeline.summary: Network18 Media & Investments Limited published Postal Ballot Notice advertisements in *Financial Express* (English) and *Navshakti* (Marathi) on May 12, 2026, via **Vikas Gupta** and **Shweta Gupta**.
On October 22, 2026, NCLT Mumbai Bench sanctioned the scheme of amalgamation of wholly-owned subsidiary News18 Marathi Private Limited with Network18.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹544.67 Cr (+9.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹51.8 Cr (+27.3% YoY) (includes ₹107.19 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹54.23 Cr).
